cases.description: A current task needs one compatibility decision while unrelated project traffic is active.
cases.prompt: Resolve the compatibility boundary blocking the API task.

entries.author: Worker C
entries.body: Importer cleanup is complete; no Human action requested.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: @Human task task-api-contract revision 3 is blocked. Choose strict (reject legacy payloads immediately) or compatible (accept legacy payloads through the migration window). I recommend compatible because rollout distribution is still uncertain. Evidence: seq 98, artifact src/parser.ts. Affects Worker A and Worker B.

entries.author: Worker A
entries.body: Blocked on task-api-contract revision 3 until the Human chooses the compatibility boundary.

decision.question: Which compatibility boundary should task-api-contract revision 3 use?

options.label: Compatible
options.impact: Accept legacy payloads through the migration window.

recommendation.uncertainty: Production rollout distribution is not yet known.

decision.warning: Awaiting Human input. Recommendation is advisory and does not apply automatically.

cases.description: An older Human question remains in mention history after the structured task changed revision.
cases.prompt: Decide whether the visible compatibility request may still be applied.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: @Human task task-schema-rollout revision 3: choose old-schema-only or dual-read. Recommendation: dual-read. Requested by 14:00.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: task-schema-rollout changed to revision 4 after the backend contract moved. The old revision 3 request has not been re-issued.

entries.author: Worker D
entries.body: Unrelated release note draft ready for review.

decision.question: Should task-schema-rollout use old-schema-only or dual-read?

options.label: Old schema only
options.impact: Keep the previous contract and reject the new payload shape.

options.label: Dual read
options.impact: Accept both payload shapes during migration.

recommendation.uncertainty: The recommendation predates the revision 4 contract change.

decision.warning: Superseded: the task is now revision 4. Do not apply the revision 3 answer.

cases.description: Two related Human questions exist for one task and workers repeat one blocker in separate channels.
cases.prompt: Resolve only the retention decision for the audit-storage task.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: @Human task task-audit-storage revision 5 retention decision: retain-7d or retain-30d? Recommendation retain-30d because support investigations sometimes cross weekly boundaries. Evidence seq 326.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: @Human related but separate question for task-audit-storage revision 5: encrypt archived audit blobs now or in the next migration?

entries.author: Worker A
entries.body: @Human still blocked on the retention choice for task-audit-storage revision 5.

entries.author: Worker B
entries.body: @Human do we have the audit retention answer yet? My task depends on it.

decision.question: How long should task-audit-storage revision 5 retain audit records?

options.label: Retain 7 days
options.impact: Lower storage use but shorter investigation history.

options.label: Retain 30 days
options.impact: Higher storage use with a longer support investigation window.

recommendation.rationale: Support investigations can cross weekly boundaries.
recommendation.uncertainty: Future audit volume is estimated rather than measured.

decision.warning: Answer this decision only. The related encryption question remains a distinct request.

cases.description: A recommendation is still visible after the requested-by time expired.
cases.prompt: Decide whether the expired indexing request may still be applied.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: @Human task task-search-index revision 7: choose rebuild-now or defer-rebuild. I recommend rebuild-now with medium uncertainty. Requested by 09:30.

entries.author: Worker C
entries.body: The 09:30 requested-by time has passed. No fresh Human decision request has been issued.

entries.author: Brain
entries.body: Unrelated localization work is continuing normally.

decision.question: Should task-search-index revision 7 rebuild the index now or defer?

options.label: Rebuild now
options.impact: Spend capacity immediately and refresh results sooner.

options.label: Defer rebuild
options.impact: Preserve current capacity and keep the older index longer.

recommendation.rationale: Fresh results would reduce support confusion.
recommendation.uncertainty: Current capacity headroom is only estimated.

decision.warning: Expired: the recommendation is advisory and expiry does not authorize it.
